SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS deleted, CASE WHEN c.status = 'HIDDEN' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hidden, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId}
ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id) ASC, c.id ASC
